item.title: Crime Stoppers: Homicide Investigation
item.description: Crime Stoppers and the Jackson Police Department would like to know what really happened at King Baba's.

item.title: Protests against ICE planned across the US after shootings in Minneapolis and Portland, Oregon
item.description: Protesters against immigration enforcement took to the streets in cities and towns across the country on Saturday after one federal officer fatally shot a woman in Minneapolis and another shot and wounded two people in Portland, Oregon.

item.title: Six killed in Mississippi, suspect charged with murder
item.description: Authorities have charged a 24-year-old man with murder after six people were killed in a series of related shootings Friday night in northeast Mississippi.

item.title: Trump pushes a 1-year, 10% cap on credit card interest rates and banks balk
item.description: Reviving a campaign pledge, President Donald Trump wants a one-year, 10% cap on credit card interest rates, a move that could save Americans tens of billions of dollars but drew immediate opposition from an industry that has been in his corner.

item.title: TBI Investigates State Park Officer-Involved Shooting
item.description: According to TBI, one person has died following an officer-involved shooting Friday night at Natchez Trace State Park.

item.title: Shiloh National Military Park seeks volunteers for “Wreaths Out”
item.description: Shiloh National Military Park seeks volunteers to assist with the removal of wreaths.

item.title: Volunteers tackle invasive plants at Cypress Grove Nature Park
item.description: Volunteers at Cypress Grove Nature Park are helping to remove an invasive plant species.

item.title: Jackson Chapter of Delta Sigma Theta Sorority, Inc. celebrates 113 years
item.description: The Jackson Chapter of Delta Sigma Theta Sorority, Inc. is celebrating 113 years of service to the community.

item.title: Hardeman Co. election candidates meet with residents
item.description: Hardeman County is gearing up for election day, and several area candidates were available to meet with today.

item.title: Grateful Dead founding member Bob Weir dies at 78
item.description: Bob Weir, guitarist, singer and founding member of the Grateful Dead, has died at age 78.
